I take women’s rights seriously, so this is one of the first things I asked about while visiting Ghardaïa, Algeria  Now this is not necessarily for any reason. It has nothing to do with religion or location. The only thing it has to do with is that many communities that are small and follow old traditions typically give less rights and protections to women. However, I was pleasantly surprised that this is not the case in Ghardaia.   I really appreciate what I learned about  Mozabite communities, giving women in their own committees and ability to make decisions for themselves. When it comes to dress, extra protections, to feel safe and comfortable in their marriages, and the community standing in solidarity with its women. videos.caption: 🇩🇿 Algerian rai music is one of Algeria's most iconic musical genres. It was born in the city of Oran, in western Algeria, during the early 20th century. Emerging from traditional Bedouin and folk songs performed by local singers, Raï gradually evolved by blending its rich heritage with modern instruments and rhythms. Its lyrics express everyday life, love, freedom, migration, and social issues, giving a voice to ordinary people. Thanks to the success of many Algerian artists, Raï music gained international recognition while proudly preserving its authentic Algerian identity and cultural roots. #algeria #rai #music #trending #fyp

Algeria summoned the UAE ambassador and gave him 48 hours to comply, saying it had exhausted means of preserving bilateral relations. UAE commercial flights to Algiers remain exempt until the end of 2026. Abu Dhabi said it hoped the decision would be temporary and remained committed to ties between the peoples.
